task: Force delivery-check evidence stale when the reviewed material changes after the delivery reviewer signs.
outcome: When a user runs lattice session_brief before DONE after changing source material post-delivery-check, the DONE pre-check shows delivery-check as stale and tells them to rerun lattice-review-delivery instead of showing delivery-check PASS.
facts: Baseline item 5 says delivery-check can remain visible after the material head it reviewed has changed.
delivery_check_set currently signs docsPromises, realMachineTests, closingSelfCheck, and reviewRound, but not the material binding.
DONE oracle and machine guard currently verify the delivery-check hash and docsPromises but do not compare delivery-check materialHash to current materialHash.
Existing done-required validation treats materialHash as the hard freshness binding and headHash as audit-only when material/story hashes still match.

Process-fact registry coverage is artifact/provenance level: delivery-check.json remains L4 gate evidence produced by delivery_check_set; field-level binding belongs in DeliveryCheckData, the integrity hash, and focused smoke coverage.
Older delivery-check files without materialHash must fail closed as stale for DONE evidence; this is a correctness change, not a compatibility-preserving optimization.
constraints: Do not change delivery reviewer role ownership or allow main-agent self-signing.
Do not weaken validation, review, summary, done_prepare, or delivery-check gates.
Do not treat metadata-only head drift as a reason to rerun delivery review when materialHash is unchanged.
Do not edit the immutable baseline v1 artifact; write a derived story-specific result artifact.
Do not broaden into DONE summary freshness; that is baseline item 6.
